ValidationRule.description: CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date. #21305- Made the Validation rule to apply for all Profiles and to lock the field on Won oppty #20656- Added bypass logic to edit Close Date in late stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED( CloseDate ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')),
NOT(ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate')),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT( $Permission.Edit_Close_Date_in_Late_Stage_Opp ),
NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Close Date once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
